exempt.why: The pipeline is a BOARD: its columns stand side by side and the reader scrolls along them, the way a board has always worked on a phone. A board is not a table. A table that is wider than the screen is a table with its last column cut in half — a number split down the middle, with nothing saying there is more to the right — and that is why every table in this product became a list of records below 640px.
